findings.text: The module docstring still says the hook blocks only while the manifest is absent or its top-level status is non-terminal, so the file's first statement of its own contract is wrong for the case this change adds: a terminal manifest older than the attempt is refused (reckon/hooks/worker_stop.py:173).

The in-harness lane-change branch rebuilds the run directive without an environment key, so a run re-pointed in-harness carries none of the attempt identity the same change attaches at reckon/crew/dispatch.py:4080; the only in-repo reader of a pointer's directive reads attach_with alone (reckon/hooks/native_agent_guard.py:148), so the gap is latent rather than breaking.
The refactor commit replaced a possessive with a bare noun and left the following line intact, so the docstring now reads "absent, the launch own environment is used".
